title: The most recent build's result
description: Written by the tool watching for saves, each time it rebuilds. The interface reads this to answer "why has the drawing not changed" (placed atomically, in the same manner as ADR-0018).

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. How it is raised is ADR-0018 decision 5.

ok.description: Whether the build succeeded. When false, the version from before keeps running if one was running; on the first build, or after the running sketch exited on its own, nothing is running. A sketch that was started but ended before it drew its first frame does not make this false: the build did succeed, and that case is recorded as launched false with a notStartedReason.

status.description: The build's exit code. 128 plus the signal number when the build was ended by a signal, as a shell reports it.

output.description: The build's output. What went wrong goes here. When the build succeeded but the sketch was not started (launched is false), the reason it was not started comes first and the build's output follows after a blank line: the reason is everything before the first blank line (it can span several lines but never contains a blank line). The same reason is also in notStartedReason. When the sketch was started but ended with a failure before drawing its first frame, the reason has a second line: the first line of what the sketch itself reported (a failed setup() or a failed build of the sketch), and the sketch's whole account of it follows the reason, before the build's output. Records written before notStartedReason existed (launched false with only the build's output) do not lead with a reason: without notStartedReason, do not read the first line of output as one. Warnings can appear even on success.

stamp.description: Which generation of the source this build was made from. The same value as the stamp in an observation reply.

configuration.description: Which configuration it was built with. Numbers cannot be compared without knowing which ground they came from.

launched.description: Whether the swapped-in sketch came up. If absent, the writer predates this field (read ok alone). ok true with this false means it built but is not running, which is the one shape where a frozen drawing reads as success. It is also the shape of a sketch that was started but failed (a nonzero exit code, or a signal) before it drew its first frame: the record written when it was started is rewritten with launched false and the reason in notStartedReason, and the version from before keeps running if it had drawn a frame, otherwise nothing is running. A sketch that exited with code 0 on its own is not recorded this way. It is not in required because putting it there would stop older writers' records from validating (the shape ADR-0018 decision 5's revision hit with frames).

notStartedReason.description: Why the sketch was not started, when the build passed but the sketch was not started (ok true, launched false), including a sketch that ended with a failure before it drew its first frame. Non-empty, and never contains a blank line; it can span several lines and the first line is the headline. It is the same text that leads output. Absent when the sketch was started (a record written when it was started is rewritten to carry this field if the sketch is then found to have failed before drawing its first frame) and when the build failed, and also in records written before this field existed. It is not in required because putting it there would stop older writers' records from validating (the same reason as launched). This is what tells a record that names its reason from an old one that does not.

timings.description: How long it took, broken down (milliseconds). Looking only at the total means guessing at what is slow, and guessing wrong. From noticing the change to the new picture showing is detectMs + buildMs + firstFrameMs. firstFrameMs counts from the same moment as relaunchMs and so contains all of it: do not add both. The wait between saving and the watcher noticing (up to one polling interval) is in none of them.

detectMs.description: From noticing the change to starting the build, which is the wait for a build already running. It does not start at the save itself: the watcher sees only a stamp of the sources, not when they were saved. Omitted on the first build.

buildMs.description: How long the build itself took.

relaunchMs.description: Swapping it in: from winding down the old sketch to having started the new one. It stops once the new process is started, before any picture from it shows; firstFrameMs covers that. Omitted when the build failed.

firstFrameMs.description: From starting the swap to the new sketch's first frame being taken up by the tool's window. Not in the record when it is first written: the watcher adds it and rewrites the record once the window signals the change. Omitted when the watcher has no window (nothing signals it), when no picture had been shown yet (the first signal does not wait for a frame), when the previous version had not shown yet and was still running (the signal could be for either), and when a later record replaced this one first.
